name: io.github.lexus2016/turbo-quant-memory
title: Turbo Quant Memory
description: Local-first memory and knowledge graph for coding agents. Compact retrieval, no network.

packageArguments.description: Run the memory server over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: TQMEMORY_FTS_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Snowball stemmer for the BM25 lane. Use Russian for Cyrillic-dominant corpora.

environmentVariables.name: TQMEMORY_EMBEDDING_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Embedder backend. Default fastembed (ONNX); sentence-transformers needs the [torch] extra.

environmentVariables.name: TQMEMORY_MIGRATE_ON_STARTUP
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to apply pending schema migrations automatically on startup.

environmentVariables.name: TQMEMORY_SECRETS_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Argon2id passphrase for the secrets vault on headless hosts. Omit to use the OS keyring.
